albedo.Metal: Use case: lighting-weather. Image 1 is the edit target Metal, a transparent top-down RTS resource deposit decal. Convert it into an unlit PBR albedo/base colour texture. Remove ALL directional shadows, highlights and ambient occlusion, replacing them with neutral material colour; preserve rust, ore veins, crystals, oil stains, dirt and material identity. Keep exact composition, scale, outline, object positions, transparent coverage and overhead camera. No baked illumination, no cast shadows, no specular reflections. Transparent background. No text or framing.

normal.Metal: Use case: precise-object-edit. Image 1 is the edit target, the unlit albedo texture of the Metal RTS resource node. Output only a registered tangent-space RGB normal map for low-relief geometry of exactly this image. Preserve exact scale, occupied bounding box, object positions, outline, rotation and overhead framing; no zoom or recentering. Standard OpenGL RGB normals: red positive X points right, green positive Y points upwards, blue positive Z. Flat ground/background must be uniform exact RGB (128,128,255), no lighting or shading applied to the normal colours, no gradients on flat background. Low restrained bevels on rocks, crystals and scrap, very shallow fluid film where relevant. No albedo colours, no text, no extra objects. Opaque map.
